question: What happens to those who are many-minded and attached to enjoyment?
premises: they are confused and under delusion
they are attached to sense enjoyments
inference: delusion leads to fall into hell and rebirth
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are kept whole
plain_english: Many-minded and confused, gone under delusion's control, attached to sense enjoyments, they fall into impure hell; lacking certainty, they fall into hell beginning with avīci, in the continuum of birth and death.
